name: THE LENSBABY UNIVERSE: CREATIVE DEFOCUS & SWEET SPOTS
message:
Take a picture and capture a [SUBJECT MATTER] using the unmistakable physical artifacts of a creative shift-and-tilt optic system. The final image isolates a specific zone of interest within [ENVIRONMENT], shifting the focal plane dramatically so that a localized slice remains hyper-detailed, while the rest of the canvas surrenders to a specialized [OPTIC EFFECT]. The frame is wrapped in [LIGHTING & ATMOSPHERE], emphasizing the soft edge-smearing, painterly textures, and organic lens flares that define experimental analog glass, 8k resolution, authentic optical physics simulation.

ADDITIONAL INSTRUCTIONS
The primary technical goal is simulating the tangible, flawed charm of bellows-based and selective-focus optics rather than uniform digital post-processing. The plane of focus must transition smoothly but rapidly based on the selected optic effect (radial, swirly, or tilted linear). Maintain crisp micro-contrast and realistic texture rendering (such as skin texture, fabric weaves, or leaf cuticles) strictly inside the zone of focus. Ensure that out-of-focus specular highlights stretch, warp, or bloom organically without creating digital staircase artifacts, synthetic gaussian blurs, or uniform miniature-world effects.

NEGATIVE PROMPT
perfect corner-to-corner sharpness, clinical digital rendering, uniform depth of field, standard flat lighting, post-production gaussian blur, artificial blur filters, uniform miniature effect, harsh digital noise, geometric grid alignment, over-sharpened borders, flat monochromatic backgrounds.

RANDOMIZATION RECOMMENDATION
Randomization is highly recommended for this preset. Pairing clinical or mechanical subject matter with organic, swirly bokeh patterns and soft woodland lighting often creates striking, fine-art juxtapositions that perfectly capture the experimental ethos of the Lensbaby system.

CREATIVE STRATEGY
The "Option Groups" architecture is chosen because Lensbaby is not a single look—it is an ecosystem of interchangeable optics (Sweet, Twist, Velvet, Edge) and tilting lens bodies. By decoupling the core subject from the environment, the optic behavior, and the lighting atmosphere, this preset replicates the physical experience of a photographer swapping inserts and tilting a composite lens body. The master prompt locks in the essential physics of non-planar focus, while the variables allow users to explore everything from dreamy portraits to dynamic, kinetic street scenes.

VISUAL DNA ANALYSIS
Cinematic Identity: Avant-garde, indie filmmaking, dream sequences, and poetic fine-art documentary styles.

Atmosphere: Intimate, ethereal, nostalgic, and deeply subjective—simulating human memory or emotional focus.

Framing: Medium close-up to macro execution, using spatial distortion to enforce a strict, unmissable visual hierarchy.

Tone: Artistically deliberate, moody, expressive, and anti-clinical.

Materiality: A stark contrast between hyper-tactile, sharp focus textures and completely liquefied, streaked, or swirling backgrounds.

Color Relationship: Highly sensitive to specular light, converting ordinary background light sources into oversized, painterly shapes and bleeding washes of saturated color.

Visual Storytelling: By intentionally introducing optical distortion and discarding peripheral information, the frame forces an emotional connection with the isolated subject, turning ordinary environments into impressionistic canvases.

name: THE NOCTURNAL F/0.95: INFINITE DEPTH SEPARATION
message:
Take a picture and capture a [SUBJECT MATTER] frame that demonstrates the extreme optical characteristics of a 58mm f/0.95 lens aperture. The composition centers on a razor-thin plane of focus slice cutting through [ENVIRONMENT], where the primary subject is rendered in hyper-sharp detail, while the foreground and background dissolve immediately into [BOKEH RENDERING STYLE]. The scene is illuminated by [LIGHTING STYLE], creating point-light highlights that reveal the physical textures and atmospheric depth of the space, 8k resolution, photorealistic rendering.

ADDITIONAL INSTRUCTIONSThe primary technical goal is simulating the signature look of high-end, wide-open glass: a transition from razor-sharp focus to complete blur that happens within millimeters. The rendering must strictly maintain crisp texture detail on the exact plane of focus (e.g., skin pores, textile weave, metallic ridges) while keeping out-of-focus light sources perfectly clean—avoid "onion-ring" patterns inside the bokeh discs or harsh digital noise. Ensure there is absolutely no digital sharpening artifacting.NEGATIVE PROMPTdeep depth of field, sharp background, flat lighting, uniform focus, harsh digital grain, onion-ring bokeh, chromatic fringing, green or purple color bleeding on edges, soft main subject, wide-angle distortion, artificial blur filters, geometric pattern noise.RANDOMIZATION RECOMMENDATIONRandomization works exceptionally well here. Coupling high-tech subjects with organic environments, or mechanical close-ups with neon-soaked rainy streets, maximizes the visual impact of the f/0.95 rendering engine.CREATIVE STRATEGYThis preset relies on an "Option Groups" setup because the visual footprint of a legendary lens like the Noct isn't defined by what it shoots, but how it resolves space. By breaking the prompt into Subject, Environment, Bokeh Style, and Lighting, the underlying optical math (the fixed master prompt rules) remains consistent while allowing the user to test the extreme shallow depth of field across wildly different thematic domains. The core creative trick is keeping the camera parameters fixed while swapping the canvas underneath.VISUAL DNA ANALYSISCinematic Identity: Grounded in premium large-format cinematography and high-end street portraiture.Atmosphere: Intimate, isolating, mysterious, and deeply atmospheric.Framing: Medium close-up to macro execution, forcing the eye onto a singular point of interest.Tone: Moody, quiet, contemplative, and technically immaculate.Materiality: High physical contrast—metal, glass, wet surfaces, and skin textures contrasted against completely liquefied backgrounds.Color Relationship: Rich, deep black levels paired with intensely saturated, blooming point-lights (neons, lamps, reflections).Storytelling: The composition creates an immediate narrative hierarchy; whatever is in focus becomes the absolute, undeniable protagonist of the frame.

NEGATIVE PROMPT
deep depth of field, sharp background, flat lighting, uniform focus, harsh digital grain, onion-ring bokeh, chromatic fringing, green or purple color bleeding on edges, soft main subject, wide-angle distortion, artificial blur filters, geometric pattern noise.

RANDOMIZATION RECOMMENDATION
Randomization works exceptionally well here. Coupling high-tech subjects with organic environments, or mechanical close-ups with neon-soaked rainy streets, maximizes the visual impact of the f/0.95 rendering engine.

CREATIVE STRATEGY
This preset relies on an "Option Groups" setup because the visual footprint of a legendary lens like the Noct isn't defined by what it shoots, but how it resolves space. By breaking the prompt into Subject, Environment, Bokeh Style, and Lighting, the underlying optical math (the fixed master prompt rules) remains consistent while allowing the user to test the extreme shallow depth of field across wildly different thematic domains. The core creative trick is keeping the camera parameters fixed while swapping the canvas underneath.

VISUAL DNA ANALYSIS
Cinematic Identity: Grounded in premium large-format cinematography and high-end street portraiture.

Atmosphere: Intimate, isolating, mysterious, and deeply atmospheric.

Framing: Medium close-up to macro execution, forcing the eye onto a singular point of interest.

Tone: Moody, quiet, contemplative, and technically immaculate.

Materiality: High physical contrast—metal, glass, wet surfaces, and skin textures contrasted against completely liquefied backgrounds.

Color Relationship: Rich, deep black levels paired with intensely saturated, blooming point-lights (neons, lamps, reflections).

Storytelling: The composition creates an immediate narrative hierarchy; whatever is in focus becomes the absolute, undeniable protagonist of the frame.
